careers.title: Agricultural Scientist / Agronomist
careers.description: Conduct research in breeding, physiology, production, yield, and management of crops and agricultural plants or trees, shrubs, and nursery stock, their growth in soils, and control of pests; or study the chemical, physical, biological, and mineralogical composition of soils as they relate to plant or crop growth. May classify and map soils and investigate effects of alternative practices on soil and crop productivity.
careers.work_reality_summary: Splits between field trials, laboratory work, and advisory contact with farmers. Government and ICAR institute roles are stable and follow published recruitment cycles. Field seasons dictate the calendar, and postings are frequently rural, which is a genuine advantage for students who want to stay near agricultural home districts.

india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: B.Sc (Hons.) Agriculture
india_entry_routes.low_cost_alternative_route: State Agricultural Universities charge low fees and exist in nearly every state, often with hostel subsidies

india_entry_routes.route_name: B.Sc Agriculture then M.Sc and ICAR research service
india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: M.Sc Agriculture, with ARS eligibility for research service
india_entry_routes.low_cost_alternative_route: ICAR fellowships pay a stipend during postgraduate study, making this route effectively funded for selected candidates

prerequisites: Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Mathematics in 10+2
risks_and_tradeoffs: Private sector agribusiness roles are fewer than the number of graduates produced.
Government recruitment cycles are irregular and highly competitive.
Field postings are rural, which suits some students and not others.
careers.regional_caveats: State Agricultural Universities have strong regional ties and their graduates are favoured in state agriculture department recruitment. This is one of the strongest options for students who cannot or do not want to leave an agricultural region.

careers.title: Chartered Accountant
careers.description: Examine, analyze, and interpret accounting records to prepare financial statements, give advice, or audit and evaluate statements prepared by others. Install or advise on systems of recording costs or other financial and budgetary data.
careers.work_reality_summary: Deadline-driven work concentrated around statutory filing and audit seasons, when weeks of long hours are standard. The articleship period means roughly three years of low-paid apprenticeship. Once qualified, the credential is portable and respected, and independent practice is a realistic option.

india_entry_routes.route_name: CA Foundation route directly after Class 12
india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: Chartered Accountant (ICAI membership)
india_entry_routes.low_cost_alternative_route: ICAI's own study material is included in the registration fee; expensive private coaching is optional, not required

india_entry_routes.route_name: B.Com followed by the CA Direct Entry route
india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: B.Com plus Chartered Accountant

prerequisites: Any stream in 10+2; Accountancy and Mathematics help but are not mandatory
risks_and_tradeoffs: Pass rates at each ICAI level are low, and many candidates take several attempts or do not finish.
Articleship pays a small stipend for roughly three years while peers are already earning.
The coaching industry around CA is expensive and aggressively marketed; it is not mandatory.
Without a parallel degree, an incomplete CA leaves little formal qualification to fall back on.
careers.regional_caveats: ICAI examinations are national and identical everywhere, making this one of the most geographically fair routes in this catalogue. Articleship opportunities are better in cities with more firms.

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.description: Perform engineering duties in planning, designing, and overseeing construction and maintenance of building structures and facilities, such as roads, railroads, airports, bridges, harbors, channels, dams, irrigation projects, pipelines, power plants, and water and sewage systems.
careers.work_reality_summary: Work splits between site visits and office design work, with the balance shifting toward site early in a career. Site postings often mean living away from home, in smaller towns, and outdoors in difficult weather. Government roles are stable and slower-paced; private contractor roles pay more and demand longer hours against project deadlines.

Private-sector pay at entry level is lower than in software or finance for comparable qualifications.
Construction hiring is cyclical and tracks government infrastructure spending.
careers.regional_caveats: Public infrastructure work is distributed across states, so this is one of the few engineering paths with genuine opportunity outside metros. Government recruitment (state PWD, PSUs) runs on published exam cycles.

careers.description: Develop, introduce, or enact laws and statutes at the local, tribal, state, or federal level. Includes only workers in elected positions.
careers.work_reality_summary: Preparation dominates several years of life before any appointment, with a very low success rate. The responsibility and public impact are real, and so is the frustration of working inside slow systems.

The private coaching industry around this examination is expensive and its advertised success claims are frequently unverifiable.
careers.regional_caveats: State PSC examinations are often conducted in the regional language, which advantages local candidates. This career has no dated market evidence attached because it is a recruitment process rather than a labour market.

careers.title: Clinical Psychologist
careers.description: Assess, diagnose, and treat mental and emotional disorders of individuals through observation, interview, and psychological tests. Help individuals with distress or maladjustment understand their problems through their knowledge of case history, interviews with patients, and theory. Provide individual or group counseling services to assist individuals in achieving more effective personal, social, educational, and vocational development and adjustment. May design behavior modification programs and consult with medical personnel regarding the best treatment for patients.
careers.work_reality_summary: Sustained one-to-one work with people in distress, which carries a real emotional load and requires supervision and self-care to sustain. Building a private practice takes years to reach a stable income.
careers.regional_caveats: Licensed training centres are concentrated in a handful of cities, notably Bengaluru (NIMHANS), Delhi, and Kolkata. Practice opportunities are strongest in urban areas.

careers.title: UX / Product Designer
careers.description: Design digital user interfaces or websites. Develop and test layouts, interfaces, functionality, and navigation menus to ensure compatibility and usability across browsers or devices. May use web framework applications as well as client-side code and processes. May evaluate web design following web and accessibility standards, and may analyze web use metrics and optimize websites for marketability and search engine ranking. May design and test interfaces that facilitate the human-computer interaction and maximize the usability of digital devices, websites, and software with a focus on aesthetics and design. May create graphics used in websites and manage website content and links.
careers.work_reality_summary: The work is research, structure, and iteration far more than visual polish. Much of it is meetings, negotiating with engineers about what is buildable, and justifying decisions with evidence. It is a strong destination for people switching from either design or engineering backgrounds.

india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: B.Des in Interaction / Product Design
india_entry_routes.low_cost_alternative_route: A portfolio of redesign case studies built from free tools is widely accepted in place of a design degree in this field

india_entry_routes.route_name: Switching in from engineering, psychology or design
india_entry_routes.degree_or_cert_awarded: No formal credential; a portfolio of case studies
india_entry_routes.low_cost_alternative_route: Free courseware plus self-directed case studies is the most common actual entry route into this field in India

risks_and_tradeoffs: Genuine entry-level roles are scarce; most postings expect prior product experience.
Expensive private UX bootcamps advertise heavily and their placement claims are often unverifiable.
The role's boundaries vary enormously between companies, so titles are a poor guide to actual work.
careers.regional_caveats: Almost entirely concentrated in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurugram, and Mumbai, though remote work is comparatively common.
